approval_digest_sealed_check.name: approval_digest_sealed_check
approval_digest_sealed_check.value: "approvals"."state" = 'DRAFT' OR ("approvals"."action_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "approvals"."manifest_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "approvals"."sealed_at" IS NOT NULL)

artefacts_staged_expiry_idx.name: artefacts_staged_expiry_idx
artefacts_staged_expiry_idx.where: "artefacts"."approval_id" IS NULL AND "artefacts"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

artefacts_staging_check.name: artefacts_staging_check
artefacts_staging_check.value:
("artefacts"."request_key" IS NULL AND "artefacts"."approval_id" IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    ("artefacts"."request_key" IS NOT NULL AND "artefacts"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "artefacts"."upload_ordinal" IS NOT NULL AND "artefacts"."upload_payload_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "artefacts"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND ("artefacts"."state" <> 'DELETING' OR "artefacts"."approval_id" IS NULL))

inputs_answered_check.name: inputs_answered_check
inputs_answered_check.value: ("inputs"."state" = 'ANSWERED') = ("inputs"."answer" IS NOT NULL AND "inputs"."attestation" IS NOT NULL AND "inputs"."respondent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inputs"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL)
